WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-15' AS start_date, DATE '2025-12-23' AS end_date
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
res AS (
SELECT n.business_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, count(*) AS n_lines
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
WHERE n.store_id = 900
  AND n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.business_date, r.web_net_sales, r.n_lines, c.net_sales AS control_net_sales, r.web_net_sales - c.net_sales AS gap
FROM res r LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales c ON c.business_date = r.business_date AND c.store_id = 900
ORDER BY 1;

WITH o AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, fulfilment_type,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
)
SELECT coalesce(dispatch_date, order_date) AS d, status, count(*) AS orders,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN o o2 ON o2.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE coalesce(o2.dispatch_date,o2.order_date)=coalesce(o.dispatch_date,o.order_date) AND o2.status=o.status) AS lines
FROM o
WHERE coalesce(dispatch_date, order_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-12' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) AS dup_orders,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
          LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
          WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23') AS test_lines_excluded,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.channel_code IS NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23') AS web_lines_null_channel_code,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS web_lines_without_order,
       (SELECT round(sum(r.refund_net),2) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23') AS returns_in_range;
